## 发布流水线修复

本次预览版修复了原生双架构发布中单平台 OCI 候选镜像的身份与证明材料校验。`amd64` 与 `arm64` 仍会原生并行构建，并在合并、冒烟测试、Docker Scout 与摘要一致性校验全部通过后才发布。

`1.4.0-preview.3` 只保留了 Git 标签，没有生成可下载的 Docker 镜像或 GitHub Release；请直接使用本版本或可变标签 `preview`。

产品功能与上一可下载预览版一致。HTTP/HTTPS `.strm` 支持仍为实验功能，仅支持指向直接媒体资源的 HTTP/HTTPS 地址；暂不支持 RTSP、MMS、HLS/M3U8、自定义请求头或 Cookie，也不提供远程转码。

如遇到扫描、匹配、拖动播放或兼容性问题，欢迎通过 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RichesChiu/mova/issues) 或 [Telegram](https://t.me/mova_feedback) 反馈。

本次升级无需数据库迁移、媒体库重扫或缓存重建。

---

## Release pipeline fix

This preview fixes identity and supply-chain attestation validation for single-platform OCI candidates in the native multi-platform release pipeline. Native `amd64` and `arm64` builds still run in parallel and are published only after merge, smoke, Docker Scout, and digest consistency gates pass.

`1.4.0-preview.3` reserved only a Git tag and did not produce a downloadable Docker image or GitHub Release. Use this version or the mutable `preview` tag instead.

Product behavior is unchanged from the previous downloadable preview. HTTP/HTTPS `.strm` support remains experimental and is limited to direct HTTP/HTTPS media resources. RTSP, MMS, HLS/M3U8, custom request headers or cookies, and remote transcoding are not supported.

Please report scanning, matching, seeking, or compatibility problems through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/RichesChiu/mova/issues) or [Telegram](https://t.me/mova_feedback).

This upgrade does not require a database migration, media library rescan, or cache rebuild.
